question: Which of the following architectural elements is excluded from the construction sites of the Indus Valley Civilisation?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Iron Slabs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Iron Slabs** were not used in the construction sites of the **Indus Valley Civilisation**.
 
• The Indus Valley Civilisation existed during the **Bronze Age (3300–1300 BCE)**, a period before the widespread use of iron.
